verdict.rationale: LM Studio is a local LLM runtime that serves models on OpenAI-like endpoints, so a serving-throughput story is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions continuous batching, chunked prefill, concurrent request handling, or throughput tuning. The only load options documented are GPU offload and context length, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can achieve high serving throughput via continuous batching and chunked prefill
